|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| edge-inline.html | 32 | 10 / 6 / 4 / 12 | **25 / 7 / 0 / 0** | 102/102 → 102/102 | 11 → 29 of 30 | 2/2 (pretty: 2/2) | 1st → 1st |
| edge-structure.html | 41 | 14 / 6 / 4 / 17 | **32 / 9 / 0 / 0** | 125/129 → 129/129 | 15 → 33 of 30 | 10/10 (pretty: 10/10) | 2nd → 1st |

**Idempotence** (HTML→Tiptap→HTML repeated):

- browser: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical
- happyDom: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical
- jsdom: pass1→pass2 identical; pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 identical
- baseline: pass1→pass2 CHANGED (`…aph after an empty one.</p><p> Loose text directly in body.</p><p>Text directly …  vs  …aph after an empty one.</p><p>Loose text directly in body.</p><p>Text directly i…`); pass2→pass3 identical; JSON pass1 vs pass2 different

**Node converters vs. real editor:** happyDom: HTML identical, JSON identical; jsdom: HTML identical, JSON identical

**Pretty-printing (server path: prettier on placeholders, then expand):** format→load→save→format is a fixed point; one-word edit: raw diff = 2 changed lines / 2270 chars; pretty diff = 2 changed lines / 76 chars. Comments 1 → 1; attributes 30 → 33.
